chapter.verse: Tua ahih ciangin i upna tawh dikkisakna i ngah ahih ciangin eite Topa Zeisu Khazih hangin Pasian tawh i kilem hi.
Tua Topa hangin eite omna hehpihna sungah upna hangin tum theihna thu i ngah hi; Pasian’ vangliatna lamenin lungdamin i om hi.
Tua tham loin gimna i thuak ciangin i lungdam hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, gimna in thuakzawhna a piangsak hi.
Thuakzawhna in teci kilatsakna a piangsak hi. Teci kilatsakna in lawpna a piangsak hi.
Lawpna in hong zumsak lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, hong piak Kha Siangtho in Pasian’ itna eite sin sungah hong sung zo hi.
Eite in thaneemin i om lai takin a kilawm hunin Khazih in mi gilote tangding a si hi.
A dik mi tangdinga a si ding mi haksa hi. Midik tangding a si ngam mi a om kha ding hi taleh,
eite in mawh nei i hih lai takin Khazih in eite tang ding si ahih ciangin Pasian in eite hong itna hong kilangsak hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ama si tawh dikkisakna i ngah khit ciangin tua Topa hangin Pasian’ hehna tawh i kipelh zaw ding hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, eite in galte i hih lai takin ama Tapa in sihna a thuakna hangin eite in Pasian tawh kilem i hih leh, ama hin’na tawh gupna i ngah zaw ding hi.
Tua tham loin, i Topa Zeisu Khazih hangin kilemna thu i ngah zo ahih ciangin, tua Zeisu hangin Pasian kiangah i lungdam hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mi khat hangin khialhna in leitungah tung a, mawhna hangin sihna a piang mah bangin, mi khempeuhte in zong a mawh zo uh ahih ciangin, mi khempeuh tungah sihna hong tung hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, thukham a om ma-inah leitungah mawhna a om hi. Ahih hangin thukham om lo hi leh, mawhna a om hi cih nading a om kei hi.
Ahih hangin Adam’ khang pana kipan Moses’ khang dongin sihna in Adam’ khialhna bangin a khial lote nangawn a uk hi. Tua Adam in a nung ciangin hong piang ding mi’ lim ahi hi.

Ahih hangin mawhna leh hehpihna kibang lo hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, mi khat a khial ahih maninah, mi tampi a si uh ahih leh, Zeisu Khazih kici mi khat’ hehpihna thupha hanga i ngah lungdamna leh Pasian’ hehpihna thupha in mi tampi ading a kicing hi.

Mi khat’ mawhna hangin a piang na leh hehpihna a kibang kei hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, mawhna khat hangin daan thuak hen cihna thu a khen hi. Hehpihna panin mawhna tampi om napi-in mai ta hen cihna thu a khen hi.
Mi khat a khial ahih maninah, tua mi hangin sihna in a uk leh, Zeisu Khazih kici mi khat hangah hehpihna thu kicing a, dikna leh hehpihna a ngah mite in nuntakna a ukzaw ding uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin mi khat hangin mi khempeuh in daan thuak hen ci-in thu kikhenna a thuak uh mah bangin dikna tawh kipawl hihna khat hangin mi khempeuhte in nuntakna tawh kipawl dikkisakna a ngah uh hi.
Mi khat in thu a ngaih loh maninah, mi tampite in mawhnei mite a suah mah bangin, mi khat in thu a ngaih maninah mi tampite in zong dikna a ngah mite a suak uh hi.
Khialhna a khan’ nadingin Thukham in zong a hong tum hi. Ahih hangin khialhna a khan’ hangin hehpihna a khang zaw semsem hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mawhna in sihna a pian’sak mah bangin hehpihna in i Topa Zeisu Khazih hangin dikna piangsak a, nuntak tawntungna hong ngah sak hi.
